title: A request reference survives a customer rename
goal: Write a request with references, rename its customer and reread the same document to verify relationship and minutes.
prerequisites: onec.p3; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Separate reference, editable object and current presentation.
Verify persistence by rereading the document.
Distinguish document fields from the customer’s changeable name.
sections: A reference is not an edit buffer

A reference identifies an item; obtaining its object provides editable state. Changing an object field in memory does not prove persistence. Two objects may reflect different read times. Do not save a stale object after another change without an agreed conflict strategy.

The function creates a synthetic customer, service and 30-minute request, storing references in the document. Renaming the same customer should preserve the request’s customer identity and 30 minutes. Reading Клиент.Наименование should display the new name. These are three separate claims, not one visual comparison.
An empty reference is not an unknown string

A typed empty reference differs fromUndefined and an empty-name string. Existence checks follow the API and business rule. FindByCode does not create an absent item. Handle absence beforeGetObject so diagnostics identify the missing customer rather than a later incidental error.

An empty reference is a value of a specific reference type, not Undefined or empty text. Our ПередЗаписью requires customer, service and status. A name string is not a substitute for a reference. Inspect the selected entity and the application’s empty-value rule first.

Reference access looks simple, but mass traversal can cause many calls. An object suits one card; reports across many rows often need a query selecting required fields. Do not infer performance from code appearance: count calls and measure equal datasets first. P7 examines queries in detail.

This request stores no historical snapshot of the customer name. Its current presentation can change after renaming the item. A task needing an immutable name as of a document date requires separate attributes/versioning and rules. Do not infer that history from a reference; the course uses no real documents or third-party configuration.

Find an item, change its name through the object, write it and obtain a fresh object. Compare identity and value. Test an absent code without implicit creation. Preserve before/after snapshots and verify a linked request still references the same customer.

The tested incorrect variant writes 31 instead of 30 minutes. It compiles and retains the correct relationship, but fails the independent duration expectation. Reference verification does not cover other fields. Every call creates a new customer/service/document set: run once and remove the startup call afterward.
